vendorVerification: HEAD availability only; app script bodies, dynamic app endpoints and private APIs are not requested.
limitations: No JavaScript execution or visual/browser interaction occurs. Exact live script/source-map comparison checks deployment; local runtime tests and a browser review establish behavior.

No forms, carts or orders are submitted or mutated. Static app-embed/source verification does not prove popup behavior, delivery-field validation, final shipping or order creation. Those require separately authorized browser evidence.
Public review markup proves display-only controls and empty state; it cannot independently establish the authenticity of future supplied customer reviews.
CDN image recompression is accepted only with matching dimensions and decoded RGB RMSE <= 8. Font and current JavaScript source hashes must match exactly.
Only the known routes listed in the report are requested. Navigation targets are recorded; arbitrary links and checkout form actions are never followed.
